featureTransform.availableFeatures: AST/Jamendo mapped sigmoid scores and CLAP prompt similarities; no exported embeddings
featureTransform.astLogit: clip sigmoid score to [0.000001,0.999999], then log(p/(1-p)); canonicalAstOrder
featureTransform.scoreFields: featureNames fixes order; AST/Jamendo max mapped score uses same logit; CLAP similarity unchanged
featureTransform.fullScoreVector: 67 AST logits in canonicalAstOrder followed by all512 raw CLAP prompt similarities in clapDescriptionOrder; no embedding, normalization, or missing flags; all finite
featureTransform.missing: missing value becomes zero after transformation; corresponding Missing flag is one, else zero
featureTransform.standardization: Already baked into weights and bias; do not apply exported mean/scale again
featureTransform.ineligible: Use original browser baseline for ineligible heads; all 20 classes remain in evaluation
